questions.q: What problem do Package Configurations solve?
options: They let an external source override specific package properties (like connection strings) at run time, without editing the package file as it moves between environments
They speed up data flow execution by caching rows in memory
They encrypt sensitive columns inside a data flow
They automatically generate documentation for a package
questions.explain: Hard-coded values are right for one environment and wrong for the next — configurations override those properties from an external source at run time instead.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT one of the five Package Configuration types?
options: Cloud storage blob
XML configuration file
Environment variable
SQL Server table
questions.explain: The five types are XML configuration file, environment variable, registry entry, parent package variable, and SQL Server table — cloud storage blob isn't one of them.

options: A configuration where an environment variable holds the location of the actual configuration file, rather than the file's path being hard-coded
A configuration that only applies to child packages, never the parent
A configuration that never actually overrides anything
A configuration stored in a completely different SSIS project
questions.explain: An indirect configuration points an environment variable at the config file's location, so the file itself can move between environments without touching the package.

questions.q: Package Configurations require which deployment model?
options: The Package Deployment Model (the legacy model)
The Project Deployment Model only
Both models equally, with no distinction
Neither — configurations work independently of deployment model
questions.explain: Configurations are a Package Deployment Model feature; the newer Project Deployment Model uses parameters instead.

questions.q: What replaced Package Configurations for projects using the Project Deployment Model?
options: Project and Package Parameters, managed through SSIS Catalog environments
Nothing — the Project Deployment Model has no equivalent feature
Execute SQL Task
The Data Viewer
questions.explain: Parameters are the modern, strongly-typed, project-aware replacement for configurations, managed through Catalog environments covered in Chapter 8.
